items.title: Target (TGT) Stock May Be 28% Undervalued After Traffic Recovery Signs
items.summary: Target shares have surged over the past year, so the live question for investors is whether the current price around US$165.90 is fully supported by the cash flows the retailer is expected to generate. The stock has delivered a 91.6% return over the past 12 months, which puts a lot of weight on whether that move lines up with the cash the business can produce.
